study: T4.3 fixed-corpus development retrieval ablation and top-k sweep
fixed: Source corpus/bytes/quality/embedding fingerprint; question/filter/scope roster; model pins; LLM/prompt/context/token budgets; freshness/behaviour/thresholds; evaluator/rubric/hardware/package versions
transport: Fresh Python process per variant; real FastAPI ASGI, PostgreSQL, local CPU models
conditions: Serial runs, identical case order, no warmup, low-memory per-request release/reload. OS/HF caches and host load uncontrolled; one pass each, no causal latency or statistical significance claim.
review_method: Assistant manually reviewed all77 actual unique question/quote/source/scope bundles. Exact semantic group inheritance for new top-k predictions only after full binding validation, with new response SHA and PID mappings; no automatic required-fact labels or old response-hash reuse. Not independent human review.
selection_rule: Integrity gates, then complete answer correctness, required fact recall, task-support citation precision, lower end-to-end p95 then p50; development only
